entities.summary: Old Colombo Lighthouse or Colombo Fort Clock Tower is a clock tower and was a lighthouse in Colombo. The lighthouse is no longer operational, but the tower remains and functions as a clock tower. It is located at the junction of Chatham Street and Janadhipathi Mawatha in Colombo fort. Old Colombo Lighthouse is a lighthouse from Asia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
